label: 4th original token after the prefix "j o w"
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (45 sequences in 1M) that fires only during the original-input phase, almost always at t=3, right after the input prefix "j o w" (prev_tok w is 34x lift, prev2_tok o is 32x, first_tok j is 23x). Magnitude is set mainly by the current input: in_tok p gives the largest activations (top example j o w [p] at 1.58, and p holds 86% of the mass); other tokens after "j o w" (g, t, u, j, 1, q, ...) give only weak activations (<0.1 of max). Near-miss prefixes also fire, mostly when the current token is p: "h o w p" (0.23), "j o n w p" at t=4 (0.29), "j w o p" (0.16), and very weakly "o/f/e o w p". It never fires at the delimiter or during the copy phase, and does not fire on "j o w" followed by <DEL>, z or 0. The jow-at-t=3 predicate has dev F1 0.65; widening it to include "_ o w p" raises recall but lowers precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 10 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=w (+2.14), orig1=o (+1.85), prev_tok=w (+1.78), orig0=j (+1.68), prev2_tok=o (+1.58), prev3_tok=j (+1.47). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-1.77).
